question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**within**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition "**within**" indicates being inside or inside the** limits of something.**
 
• In this context, **"within the family unit"** emphasizes the idea that lasting bonds, essential values, and comfort are developed inside the family.
 
• The other options: "**between**", "**among**", and "**beyond**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence: Family plays a vital role in our lives**, serving as a source of love, support, and stability. It is within__ the family unit that we develop lasting bonds, learn essential values, and find comfort during tough times.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Between (के बीच)**: typically used to refer to something in a space separating two points.
 
• **Among (के बीच में)**: used to indicate being a member or part of a group.
 
• **Beyond (परे)**: means at or to the further side of something.
